Simpler: "dead calm out, barometer holding high, no excuse not to rot on the couch" = dead1 calm2 out3 barometer4 holding5 high6 no7 excuse8 not9 to10 rot11 on12 the13 couch14 = 14.

About 13 — 13 or 14 is fine. Let's go with "dead calm, barometer high, no excuse not to rot on the couch all day" = dead1 calm2 barometer3 high4 no5 excuse6 not7 to8 rot9 on10 the11 couch12 all13 day14 = 14.

Let's try for exactly 13: "dead calm, pressure sitting high, no excuse not to rot on the couch today" = dead1 calm2 pressure3 sitting4 high5 no6 excuse7 not8 to9 rot10 on11 the12 couch13 today14 = 14. Remove "today" = 13: "dead calm, pressure sitting high, no excuse not to rot on the couch" = dead(1) calm(2) pressure(3) sitting(4) high(5) no(6) excuse(7) not(8) to(9) rot(10) on(11) the(12) couch(13) = 13.
